summary: Harlequin rasbora is a small freshwater fish with a conspicuous black triangular patch on each side. It is a peaceful shoaling aquarium fish. A 2020 taxonomic revision distinguishes it from Trigonostigma truncata, a similar fish from the eastern Malay Peninsula.
nativeRange: The Malay Peninsula and parts of Southeast Asia.

features: Large black triangular wedge on the rear half of the body
Reddish-orange colour around the head and fins
Deeper body than several related Trigonostigma species

habitat.description: Associated with swamp-forest waters of the Malay Peninsula; closely related species can be confused in regional records.
